intended_object: An auxiliary balanced map (m, n) ↦ m ⊗ n·s. It is used to build the right S-action on the balanced tensor product M ⊗_R N. Its docstring calls it "an implementation detail of `BalancedTensorProduct.smulAddHom`".
explanation: The definition says it is an implementation detail. For each s, it gives the R-balanced map (m, n) ↦ m ⊗ (s • n). That map then induces, through the universal property, the additive endomorphism of M ⊗_R N used to define the right S-module structure. It is a step inside a proof, not a standard mathematical object in its own right. The construction itself is correct: the balance condition follows from the commutation hypothesis `SMulCommClass R Sᵐᵒᵖ N`.
